get.description:
Mean, median, standard deviation and score distribution for enrolled students.

Excused and ungraded students are always left out. Missing work is left
out by default, since a 0 for work never turned in describes effort
more than how well the class understood the material.

delete.description: Remove a student from the roster. Their grades are kept and return if they re-enroll.

put.description:
Create or replace grades for one assignment, all or nothing.

Every student must be enrolled in the assignment's course. Returns all of
the assignment's grades after the update.

post.description:
Import students from a CSV roster, optionally enrolling them in a course.

All or nothing: any bad row rejects the file with a 422 listing every
problem by line. Rows whose email matches an existing student reuse that
student, so importing the same roster twice creates no duplicates.

get.description:
A student's grade breakdown for each course they're enrolled in.

Pass `course_id` for a single course. Each assignment's `outcome` says
how it was treated: counted, dropped (drop-lowest), excused, or ungraded.
